sources.title: GLM-4.5V official model card at audited revision
sources.evidence: Names GLM-4.5V and the GLM family; explicitly announces release on 2025/08/11. Front matter declares MIT and GLM-4.5-Air-Base ancestry. Describes image/video understanding, thinking switch and tool-enabled serving. Attributes nominal 106B total and 12B active to its GLM-4.5-Air basis.

sources.title: Exact GLM-4.5V checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4vMoeForConditionalGeneration; 46 decoder layers, first dense then 45 MoE layers, hidden 4096, 128 routed experts / top 8 plus one shared expert, intermediate 1408; 96 query and 8 KV heads of dimension 128. A 24-layer, 1536-wide vision encoder, 4096 output and 10944 merger intermediate. Untied embeddings/output. max_position_embeddings 65536, no quantization_config.

sources.title: Complete exact GLM-4.5V checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: 18,106 tensor keys uniquely assigned to 46 safetensors shards. All 46 bounded JSON headers were read and matched to this inventory; full weights were not downloaded. Inventory includes complete vision/projector, input embedding and separate lm_head, with no MTP module keys.

sources.title: GLM4V MoE reference implementation matching checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: All indexed keys/shapes reconciled against configured module constructors. The 45 e_score_correction_bias tensors are explicitly registered buffers, not nn.Parameters. Remaining 18,061 BF16 tensors are learned weights/biases. Vision blocks use out_hidden_size for MLP width; merger uses intermediate_size. Text embeddings and output are separate; no MTP module is instantiated.

sources.title: Exact GLM-4.5V chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts text/image/video content. Implements enable_thinking, /nothink, reasoning_content and think tags. Provides tools definitions, structured tool_call/arg_key/arg_value serialization and observation tool responses; supports general function calling rather than merely external GUI execution.

sources.title: Exact GLM-4.5V tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: model_max_length is 128000, conflicting with the exact model configuration max_position_embeddings 65536. Special tokens alone do not establish audio support. Tokenizer metadata is not used to override the configured model position limit.

sources.title: GLM-4.5V native developer documentation
sources.evidence: Names exact model, MoE architecture and nominal 106B/12B figures. Lists image/video/text/file input and text output, plus thinking/non-thinking modes. File handling is a service input format, not evidence of a separate native neural modality.16K maximum output is not the context window.

sources.title: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking technical report, revision6
sources.publisher: GLM-V Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: Introduction explicitly labels GLM-4.5V 106B-A12B. Section2 identifies its GLM-4.5-Air language decoder, AIMv2-Huge-initialized vision encoder and MLP adapter, with 3D patch convolution and text token completions. The exact model supports thinking/non-thinking. These nominal counts do not define an exact GLM-4.5V checkpoint counting boundary or imply inclusion of Air MTP weights.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated checkpoint at revisioned47433b37111465ec527affaaddceff371bca04. Reports 107710927360 BF16 elements and 5760 F32 elements. Full module/header reconciliation identifies the F32 elements as router correction buffers and the BF16 elements as learned parameters; raw storage-element total 107710933120 is not the learned-parameter count.

name.note: Exact vision-language variant, distinct from GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air.

developer.note: Developer brand is Z.ai; report credits the Zhipu AI GLM-V team with Tsinghua University collaborators.

family.note: GLM vision-language family using GLM-4.5-Air as its language component.

release_date.note: Official card explicitly dates the GLM-4.5V release 2025/08/11; confirmed day precision, independent of later report revisions.

open_weights.note: Public exact checkpoint index and all 46 shard headers accessible; report/card explicitly open-source this model.

license.note: Exact model card front matter and repository metadata declare MIT. This assessment concerns weights; separate framework or report licenses are not substituted.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint learned-parameter total 107,710,927,360: 106,852,245,504 language parameters including untied input embeddings and output head, plus 858,681,856 vision/projector parameters. All 18,061 parameter tensors reconciled, across all 46 shards. Excludes 45 explicitly registered router correction buffers (5,760 F32 elements); all parameters are BF16, no quantized packing/scales. No MTP keys or modules in this exact checkpoint. Published 106B is nominal; the Air report convention excluding embeddings/output and including MTP is not transferred to this VLM.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal 12B activation figure, directly stated for GLM-4.5V and its language basis. It is not an exact active count reconstructed from the checkpoint and does not establish a vision-encoding phase count. Sources do not define a complete exact VLM active-count boundary; no Air MTP convention is assumed.

architecture.note: Transformer vision encoder/projector plus MoE language decoder: 46 language layers, first dense, 45 routed-expert layers; 128 routed experts per MoE layer, top 8 selected plus 1 shared expert.

context_window.note: Use explicit max_position_embeddings 65536 of the exact released model configuration. Tokenizer model_max_length 128000 disagrees and is disclosed; native guide 16K is a maximum output limit, not context. Baseline 64000 is not established by these exact primary artifacts.

modalities.note: Exact model accepts image/video/text and generates text. API file input is document/media preprocessing. Neither file formats nor unused audio special tokens establish audio input or image/audio/video generation.

reasoning.note: Exact model supports switchable thinking/non-thinking, with reasoning_content and think tags in its template.

tool_call.note: Exact model template serializes tool schemas, assistant tool calls with arguments, and observation responses; official serving instructions enable glm45 tool-call parsing and automatic tool choice.

description.value: MoE vision-language model based on GLM-4.5-Air, with image and video understanding, switchable reasoning, and text tool calls.
description.note: Neutral description limited to supported architecture, modalities and explicit modes.

patch.description: MoE vision-language model based on GLM-4.5-Air, with image and video understanding, switchable reasoning, and text tool calls.

patch.notes: Exact full checkpoint total is 107,710,927,360 learned parameters, including 106,852,245,504 language parameters with untied embeddings/output and 858,681,856 vision/projector parameters. All 46 bounded headers and 18,061 learned tensors were reconciled; 45 router correction buffers (5,760 F32 values) are excluded. This exact checkpoint contains no MTP module. Published 106B total and 12B active are nominal; 12B is retained as the author-reported active figure, with no exact VLM or vision-phase boundary asserted and no Air MTP counting convention transferred. Model position limit 65536 conflicts with tokenizer limit 128000; 16K in native API documentation is maximum output. Native outputs are text; PDF/file handling does not add a neural modality.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Adds MIT, exact full 107.71092736B learned-parameter count, author-nominal 12B active and MoE architecture; changes context from 64000 to configured 65536 while documenting tokenizer 128000 conflict. Confirms August 11 release, text/image/video input, text output, thinking and structured tool calls. Complete 46-shard bounded-header/module reconciliation excludes router buffers and establishes that this checkpoint has no MTP module. No full weights downloaded; no active count derived by transferring Air counting conventions.
